topology_reasoning.device_interpretation: Single-port-to-single-port rectangular spiral delay line / compact waveguide coil. The black material is one continuous constant-width layer-(1,0) waveguide with two open ends on the lower-right side. It uses nested rounded rectangular turns to pack optical path length into a 173.5 by 59.5 um footprint, with an inner left loop that returns into the long inner straight section.
topology_reasoning.operating_principle: The function is governed by total guided path length and bend loss. The long folded path supplies delay/phase accumulation; constant pitch keeps adjacent turns separated, and large rounded turns reduce bend loss.
function_defining_knobs: path_scale_x and path_scale_y control the absolute footprint fit
path_offset_x_um and path_offset_y_um position the reconstructed centerline before absolute raster alignment
delta_length controls a real terminal trim section that changes total path length and material area
simplified centerline control points define the nested spiral topology derived from the calibrated bitmap
topology_reasoning.primitive_strategy: Build a single gf.Path from centerline control points and extrude it with a constant-width CrossSection on layer (1,0). This uses only gf.Path plus extrusion, no catalog stencil components and no raw polygon drawing.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitives-only gf.Path extrusion from calibrated centerline control points; wg_width_um set to 0.50 based on target material-width sweep. IoU exceeded 0.85, so iteration stopped.
